source.author: cic
source.text: duo milia iugerum campi Leontini Sex. Clodio rhetori assignasti et quidem immunia, ut populi Romani tanta mercede nihil sapere disceres.
source.text_original: duo milia iugerum campi Leontini Sex. Clodio rhetori assignasti et quidem immunia, ut populi Romani tanta mercede nihil sapere disceres.
source.text_english: You assigned two thousand iugera of the Leontine plain to Sextus Clodius the rhetorician, and indeed tax-free, so that you might learn, at such great cost to the Roman people, to know nothing.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: completur in me tritum uulgi sermone prouerbium: oleum perdit et inpensas, qui bouem mittit ad ceroma haec non est illius culpa, cuius sub persona alius agit tragoediam, sed magistrorum eius, qui illum magna mercede nihil scire docuerunt.
reuse.text_original: completur in me tritum uulgi sermone prouerbium: oleum perdit et inpensas, qui bouem mittit ad ceroma haec non est illius culpa, cuius sub persona alius agit tragoediam, sed magistrorum eius, qui illum magna mercede nihil scire docuerunt.
reuse.text_english: The proverb, worn thin by common use, is fulfilled in me: he wastes his oil and his money who sends an ox to the oiling-pit. It is not the fault of the man under whose name another plays the tragedy, but of his teachers, who taught him nothing at great cost.
